result:
T12 is built. Report:

**Exported signatures**
- `agentSettings.ts`: `type ChatPermissionMode = 'auto'|'bypass'`; `CHAT_PERMISSION_MODE_KEY`; `CHAT_PERMISSION_MODE_EVENT = 'dc-chat-permission-mode'`; `readChatPermissionMode(vault): ChatPermissionMode`; `writeChatPermissionMode(bus, vault, mode)`. Field gone from `AgentSettings`/`DEFAULT_AGENT_SETTINGS`/`coerceAgentSettings`; every other field keeps its global path untouched.
- `brainSyncPrefs.ts`: `readAutoCheckpointOnOpen(vault)`, `writeAutoCheckpointOnOpen(vault, enabled)`.
- `chatEntities.ts`: `knownMediaBox(vault, path)`, `rememberMediaBox(vault, path, w, h)` over `Map<vault, Map<path, Box>>` + `Set<vault>` latch; `MEDIA_BOX_MAX` and LRU now bound **per vault**.

**Scoped vs global** — SCOPED: `chatPermissionMode` (permission gate; one realm = bypass leaks to untouched projects), `autoCheckpointOnOpen` (real git auto-commit, per repo), `githubSyncSeen` (`brain enable` is per-vault), `chat.mediaBoxes` (bare relative paths collide). GLOBAL untouched: `aboutSeen` (lives in the user's head), `sidebarCollapsed` (one rail per window — state hoisted, key unchanged), `agent:settings:v1` remainder (server-mirrored).

**Deviation from the pinned contract, deliberate:** `readChatPermissionMode` does **not** call `readScopedRaw` — that helper *moves* a bare-key value into the first vault that reads it, which is the opposite of "drop the legacy value". My own test caught it failing open. It now builds `${SCOPE_PREFIX}${vault ?? ''}:${KEY}` directly, so the bare name is never read, for a null vault either. Observable contract unchanged and strengthened. A `noMigrate?: boolean` in `ScopeOpts` would be the tidier home — that's T1's file, so I left it.

**Checks** — (1) ✅ only the new accessors mention the field. (2) ✅ zero errors in my six files; 7 errors remain, all out of lane: 5× `AgentSurface.tsx` (**T11, next batch — expected**: `:286,:287,:477,:660,:2230`), 1× `ProjectInstance.tsx:189` (**pre-existing**, T6/T10 handoff on `ShellProps` — I touched neither file), 1× `BrainSyncControl.tsx:159` (**stopped on — see below**). (3) ✅ 390/390 green across all 8 tests importing my modules, including the three named. (4) ❌ `npm run build` exits non-zero on exactly those 7 errors and nothing else — it cannot pass until T11 lands; the plan's own W3 gate is end-of-wave. (5) ✅ diff is my six files + 2 tests.

**Tests I updated** — `agent-settings.test.ts`: the `chatPermissionMode` coercer block moved to `readChatPermissionMode`; "only an exact 'bypass' opts in, everything else is auto" is asserted identically, plus new per-vault isolation, legacy-drop, and bus-not-window cases. `chat-entities.test.ts`: media-box block threads a vault; every existing assertion means the same thing, plus two new ones (two projects sharing `shots/x.png`, and per-vault eviction bounds).

**STOPPED ON — one unowned caller, needs a one-line fix:** `dashboard/src/components/brain/BrainSyncControl.tsx:159` calls `readAutoCheckpointOnOpen()` with no vault and has no `useVault()` in scope. No task in the dependency map owns it. Fix: `const { vault } = useVault();` + `readAutoCheckpointOnOpen(vault)`. Until then that on-mount auto-commit decision does not typecheck. Also unowned: `src/server/routes/launcher.ts:871,882,909` still declares/coerces `chatPermissionMode` in the server mirror — now inert (the client neither sends nor reads it), but it should be deleted by whoever owns that file. One extra in-lane fix I made under the standing rule: `Sidebar.tsx` was reading its vault label from `?vault=`; it now reads `useVault().vault`.
